# objective

determine higher performing lines from 2024 data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
read.csv("MASTER Variety Trial 2023 Plant - yield.csv") -> dat


dat %>% 
  filter(site!="Waseca") %>% 
  mutate(
    variety=factor(variety),
    variety=fct_reorder(variety,combined_dry_grain_no_bag,
                        .na_rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(
    aes(variety,
        combined_dry_grain_no_bag,
        # shape = site,
        col = program)) +
      stat_summary()
  
```

-   Top variety is 1903 from UMN

-   top variety is either 701 or 801
